scenario_definition.name: 4 omitted dimensions; intended use: University Student Residence (specific CDP/PNRR grant)
scenario_definition.initial_query: I am looking for an office building. I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
scenario_definition.one_shot_query: I am looking for an office building. I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an office building to convert it into a university student residence with 60 beds under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program in Turin with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an office building.
clarifications.D: I intend to convert it into a university student residence under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program.
clarifications.Cb: I need a property with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 60 people.
clarifications.Ce: I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
clarifications.Cp: I prefer properties near public transport.

requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so the energy class must be one of A1, A2, A3, A4, B or C. The request does not mention consumption, so energy_class is used rather than epglnren_ape. No building-type filter is applied because no column for office buildings is available.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') ORDER BY id ASC
output.explanation: Filters on energy_class for classes A1-A4, B, C (energy class C or better). The office-type requirement references tipologia_bene_immobile, which is not in filterable_columns, so it was ignored per the allowlist rule. No location was supplied, so results are ordered by id ASC.
